job.job_description:
Collegedunia is Indias Largest College Discovery Platform and Personal Admission assistant. We are an education portal, matching students with the best colleges in India abroad. We help in college research, exam prep tips, application process & also provide insights on campus life.
Collegedunia ranks as countrys third best education portal by Yahoo India & Business Standard. We are also featured in Inc42, Economics times, First Post, Your Story, and many more.
Launched in 2014, we are the highest ranked portal by SimilarWeb in education. We have also been awarded as - Best Educational Portal- by IAMAI in 2017, and listed by TechinAsia as - Top 100 Start-ups in Asia.
Collegedunia is fuelled by the energy of over 450 individuals having average age around 25 years. The talent pool comprises data analysts, engineers, designers, writers, manager s, marketers, which are increasing at the rate of 10% every month.
 
ABOUT YOUR NEW JOB RESPONSIBILITIES
Developing back end website applications, Developing performant backend services.
Provisioning and managing infrastructure, deploying application code, and scaling services on AWS.
Ensuring responsiveness of applications.
Working alongside graphic designers for web design features.
Seeing through a project from conception to finished product.
Developing front end website architecture.
Designing user interactions on web pages.
Design and develop RESTful APIs to support web applications and 3rd party consumers
Staying abreast of developments in web applications and programming languages
WHAT MAKES YOU A GREAT FIT:
Degree in Computer Science.
Strong organizational and project management skills.
Proficiency with fundamental front end languages such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Experience with JavaScript frameworks such as React or Vue.
Familiarity with Next.js/Nuxt.js is a plus.
Proficiency in server-side languages such as Nodejs or Python.
Familiarity with database technology such as MongoDB, Redis, MySQL.
Good problem-solving skills.
BENEFITS:
Tools of the trade - MacBook, Latest Softwares
Monthly compensation on time
Health Insurance
Sabbatical leave
Best learning and development opportunities
A chance to have a big impact early in your career
